evidence.title: ScriptStorm.ai — AI Video Script Generator for TikTok, YouTube & Reels

name: ScriptStorm.ai
summary: AI video script generator that turns any topic into a filmable short-form script in under 30 seconds.
description: Turns a topic into a ready-to-film script for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, LinkedIn and X using the S.T.A.R.T. framework (Stop, Talk, Align, Resolve, Tell). You pick platform, tone, length and call to action, then refine the draft; paid plans include unlimited script generation.
contains: turns any topic into a script in under 30 seconds
S.T.A.R.T. framework: Stop, Talk, Align, Resolve, Tell
platform, tone, length and CTA chosen per script
scripts optimized per platform, with custom writing instructions
unlimited script generation on the paid plans
